description: A coloured strip for decoration or for separating blocks of a patch; it has no controls, inputs or outputs
menu: Preset — Rack's own presets submenu, which for this module carries five colours: Blue, Green, Red, White and Yellow
Strip Size — Narrow Strip switches this strip between narrow and wide, and Narrow Strip As Default sets which width a new Light Strip is given
Strip Colour — leads to Select Colour, Save as default and Revert to default
Select Colour — red, green and blue sliders that recolour the strip as they move, with Revert Changes to put back the colour you started with
Save as default — makes this strip's colour the one a new Light Strip is given
Revert to default — puts this strip back to the colour a new Light Strip is given
